description: Response of the quotes endpoint: priced, time-limited quotes for one trip.

last_updated.description: Last time the data in the feed was updated in POSIX time.

version.description: GOFS version number to which the feed conforms, according to the versioning framework (added in v1.1).

quotes.description: One object per quote. Empty if the trip cannot be served.

quote_id.description: Unique identifier of the quote among the quotes of the system.

brand_id.description: ID from a service brand defined in service_brands.json.

vehicle_type_id.description: ID from a vehicle type defined in vehicle_types.json.

expires_at.description: Last moment the quote can be booked, in POSIX time.

wait_time.description: Estimated number of seconds until pickup.

travel_time.description: Estimated number of seconds from pickup to drop off.

travel_distance.description: Estimated number of metres from pickup to drop off.

price.description: Price the rider will pay the operator.

is_fixed.description: true if amount is the price the rider pays; false if it is an estimate.

amount.description: The fixed price, or the most likely estimated price. In the major unit of the currency.

min_amount.description: Lowest estimated price. FORBIDDEN if is_fixed is true. In the major unit of the currency.

max_amount.description: Highest estimated price. FORBIDDEN if is_fixed is true. In the major unit of the currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amounts.

cancellation_policy.description: Cancellation terms that will apply to a booking made from this quote.

free_cancellation_period.description: Number of seconds after the booking is confirmed during which the rider can cancel without a fee.

fee.description: Fee charged when the rider cancels after free_cancellation_period, in the currency of price. In the major unit of the currency.

no_show_fee.description: Fee charged when the rider does not show up. In the major unit of the currency.

message.description: Short message to riders about the quote.
